The '''Fodurant system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Trans-Gascon sector/Legends|Trans-Gascon sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] containing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fodurant]].
